notes: Shield arithmetic: exact rationals until display; display is binary64 rho_to_eps rounded half to even to one decimal. The window is anchored per ADR 0102: an entry counts while now < anchor + 365 days, anchor = max(chargedAt, settledAt, or expires while unsettled); settledAt = max(phone clock, final version's issued) capped at expires. An unsettled entry leaves the window only after a successful lookup of the deck lineage's latest version (inputs.lookup: the expires it returned, or 'failed'). Rejecting cases are the ledger's refusals (check shield-fit or shield-ledger, rule S4..S9). The behavioral halves of S3 to S7 and S10 to S12 are simulator scenarios (sim-shield-*).
